posts.name: Turnstone
posts.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
posts.description: Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

posts.name: Tobira Site Agent
posts.tagline: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents
posts.description: People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers' ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.

posts.name: Rankfender v3.0
posts.tagline: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents
posts.description: Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

posts.name: Datastripes Data Stories
posts.tagline: Turn any spreadsheet into a data story in seconds
posts.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file and Datastripes writes the story behind it: headlines, charts and findings in plain English. Pick the questions, check your conclusion against the data, then publish in 8 formats and your brand colors. Every dataset has a story in it, but getting it out usually takes an analyst, a designer and a writer. We built Datastripes Data Story so one person with a spreadsheet can do it in minutes.

posts.name: EdgeBar
posts.tagline: Control your Mac’s volume and brightness from the trackpad
posts.description: EdgeBar turns your MacBook trackpad edges into smooth volume and brightness controls, with haptic feedback. Slide the right edge for volume and the left for brightness, with the same on-screen display as the keyboard keys and a light haptic tick as you go. Double-tap the top-right corner to mute, swipe the bottom edge to skip tracks. Lives in the menu bar, uses almost no CPU. $9 once, with lifetime updates.

posts.name: Mechvibes 3
posts.tagline: Give your keyboard and mouse any sound you like
posts.description: Mechvibes plays a sound for every key you press and every click, in any app. Pick from the community library, from mechanical switches to typewriters and game sounds, or make your own in the browser. Free and open source, for Windows, Linux and Mac.

posts.name: Pauta
posts.tagline: Your private memory for every conversation
posts.description: Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline, keeps your data on your device, and only connects to external AI if you choose.

posts.name: Cursor Craft
posts.tagline: Custom cursors for Mac
posts.description: Cursor Craft is a free macOS app for browsing, installing, and switching custom cursor sets in one click. Choose from free and premium packs across minimal, nature, neon, cats, anime, and more.

posts.name: Kodivo
posts.tagline: Learn coding with AI and PHP through swipeable cards
posts.description: Swipe through short lessons on coding with AI and PHP. Learn how coding agents work, understand code examples, and test yourself with exercises and explained answers. Connect Codex or Claude Code through MCP to continue with your saved progress.

posts.name: Winq
posts.tagline: Focus on a window or display you're looking at
posts.description: Gaze focus for macOS from your Mac's camera: look at a display or a window and Winq focuses it, with the pointer where you're looking. Head and eyes both count, it waits while you type or use the mouse, and it keeps learning from your clicks. For multi-monitor setups, developers, and anyone who wants their hands on the keyboard. On-device and private. Free for a day.

posts.name: TraceX
posts.tagline: The AI engineer for your production issues
posts.description: TraceX reads a customer's email, Slack message or Jira ticket, investigates your database, code and logs read-only, and returns the root cause with evidence for every claim, a fix as a pull request and a drafted reply. Free in private beta.

posts.name: Any Video to Text
posts.tagline: Paste a video link, get the transcript in seconds
posts.description: Paste a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook or X link and get the transcript in seconds: from the video's captions, or AI speech-to-text when it has none. You can also upload MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 or MOV files, with speaker labels for interviews and podcasts. Cooking videos get a recipe card too. Copy, summarize, or download TXT, SRT or VTT, here or in the Chrome extension. Free for 5 a day, no sign-up. Credits unlock 2-hour videos and bulk.

posts.name: Wonder Dev View
posts.tagline: Run many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel
posts.description: Run Claude Code and Codex on your subscriptions, in parallel worktrees. Have one review the other’s code, then try your app beside the design. Select an element in Preview and tell your agent what to change.

posts.name: Wisp
posts.tagline: Wisp is a little AI fairy who lives on your desktop
posts.description: Meet Wisp, your guiding light. A little fairy who lives on your desktop and does the rest. Wisp is a small spark of light that floats beside your cursor on your Mac or Windows desktop. She can see your screen, open apps, websites and files, arrange windows, and tidy folders. She also builds small software, draws sketches, makes designs, reads and replies to your email, controls your calendar, Slack, Drive and to-do lists, and plays games with you! Try Wisp for free today!

posts.name: Meadow
posts.tagline: Hidden songs on your walk, chosen by people, not algorithms
posts.description: Meadow lets you plant a song at a real place. Walk by and you can listen to what someone left there, collect it, and plant your own for the next person. No algorithm, just music that people chose for a place. Collect songs with your phone in your pocket using Live Activities, keep every find in your Garden, turn it into an Apple Music playlist, and see what your city is playing in the Feed. Free on TestFlight for iPhone.

posts.name: MacDupl
posts.tagline: Run every account in its own app
posts.description: MacDupl turns the Mac apps you already use into separate copies, each with its own login, data and Dock icon. Work and personal side by side, no logging out. New in 0.2.0: one window for every copy, one-click updates that keep logins, and a menu bar panel.

posts.name: Pressure
posts.tagline: Need a second opinion? Have two agents debate your topic
posts.description: Ask a question and two AI models from different labs argue it out, then you get a pinned summary: the positions, the concessions, the conclusion, and what is still open. Debate a decision, review a spec, research with cited sources, or pressure-test a rough idea. Start a debate on the web with no signup, add Pressure to Claude as a connector, or install the CLI for Claude Code and Codex in one line.

posts.name: Koltrix
posts.tagline: Your whole email stack, run by agents you control.
posts.description: Koltrix is a team inbox on your own domain, an email API for your product, and AI agents with inboxes of their own. You choose what each agent may do: draft, ask first, or reply when it is sure. Works with Claude and ChatGPT. 7-day trial, no card.

posts.name: Native Tasks for Obsidian
posts.tagline: A native Mac app for your Obsidian tasks
posts.description: Free native Mac task manager for people who keep tasks in Obsidian. Reads your vault's Markdown directly and writes every edit back. Tasks-plugin dates, priority, recurrence, statuses. No account, no telemetry. Pro: one-off £19.99, 7-day free trial on the direct download.

posts.name: crystl
posts.tagline: multitasking terminal for AI coding agents, built for macOS
posts.description: crystl is a free Mac terminal for AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, mixed and matched however you like. With crystl guild, launch superorchestrators that launch orchestrators that launch workers, across every project at once. Each project keeps its own context in plain markdown, and when any agent needs you, a card shows up so you can answer it in one click, on your Mac or your phone.

posts.name: BuildFerry
posts.tagline: Install iOS test builds on any iPhone with one link
posts.description: Send youripa to testers with one link. BuildFerry registers each tester's iPhone with your Apple account and re-signs the build in the cloud, so there's no UDID hunting, no Mac, no TestFlight app and no App Review. Free for one app.

posts.name: DALI AI by SupplyzPro
posts.tagline: The ERP you never need to open
posts.description: Discover SupplyzPro: a simple, all-in-one, AI-powered workspace to manage your business: sales and purchases, real-time inventory, invoicing, suppliers, payments, and more. Just text: https://wa.me/21658299567?text=hello

posts.name: Enhanced for Todoist
posts.tagline: More ways to organise, plan and focus with Todoist
posts.description: A new front end for your Todoist account, with editable tables, saved project views, flexible timeframes, workload estimates, guided reviews and a task-linked Pomodoro timer. Free and open source, with a demo you can try without signing in.

posts.name: chalk
posts.tagline: learn anything, anywhere
posts.description: chalk teaches by showing you. On your Mac, hold ⌘⌥ and ask about anything on your screen: chalk answers out loud, marks the real button, and walks you through one step at a time. Or say what you want to learn, and it draws you a board, plans a course of classes you do (not just read), or takes you through a whole project in stages. It writes up your lectures against your slides, too. Boards and courses work in any browser. Free to start.

posts.name: axel.md
posts.tagline: Agent orchestration in the terminal, designed for Rex
posts.description: Threads and named agents, back in the terminal. Axel orchestrates Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents on Rex: durable sessions, status the terminal understands, and your other machines over Tailscale.

posts.name: refern.
posts.tagline: Every visual reference you work from, in one place.
posts.description: refern keeps your images, videos, working files, and saved web pages in one library. Find any reference by tag or color, put any file on a board, and pin it on top of your drawing app. Your files stay in your own folders. Windows, macOS, and Linux.

posts.name: Thunderduck Inc.
posts.tagline: Modular Data Warehouse for Agentic Data Teams
posts.description: Thunderduck is a DuckDB-powered data warehouse built for AI agents. Every agent gets its own isolated engine. Join Postgres, BigQuery, Iceberg and S3 files in one SQL query, with no ETL. Every query is priced before it runs. Managed cloud, BYOC or on-prem.

posts.name: Codiclens
posts.tagline: Local AI powerd Mac launcher and file finder
posts.description: Describe what you want and Codiclens finds it: an app, a file or something you copied, by what's in it, not just its name. A free, open-source launcher that runs on your Mac. 100% local.

posts.name: pwned.coffee
posts.tagline: A live board of security flaws
posts.description: A live board of security flaws and incidents, brewed hourly, with one plain line on what to do now.

posts.name: Make0 Brain OSS
posts.tagline: Sync context across all your agents
posts.description: Your memories belong to you and not your agents. Whenever you are working with multiple agents you all must be encountering a problem that the context between them is not in sync. This leads to the problem of you explaining the same problem again and again. Make0 solves this problem by giving your agents a common memory store to which agents can read and write to. Introducing Make0 Brain OSS - Free, Open sourced, and MIT licensed. 🙌

posts.name: Plainmail
posts.tagline: Real email on every domain you own, for $5 a month flat
posts.description: Real mailboxes on all your domains for $5 a month, flat: up to 50 domains, 100 mailboxes and 25 GB. Ask Claude for hello@yourdomain through the MCP server, or use the CLI or API. Plainmail writes the MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records at Cloudflare, Vercel or Porkbun, checks them and creates the mailbox. It's a normal IMAP/SMTP account, so it sits in Apple Mail, the Gmail app, Outlook or Thunderbird. Built for mail between people, not bulk mail.

posts.name: Mmory
posts.tagline: Mmory is a private voice memory app for iPhone
posts.description: A private voice memory app for iPhone. Speak or type a thought, then ask for it later. Transcription and answers happen on the iPhone.

posts.name: Openroster
posts.tagline: Which "Open" companies are actually open source
posts.description: A directory of every company with "Open" in its name, plus companies that build in the open. Each page answers "Is it open source?" from the license and repo, with GitHub, OpenSSF and package stats. Open projects can launch weekly, ranked by stars gained.

posts.name: PostMyPace
posts.tagline: Turn your run into a ready-to-post Instagram Story or Reel
posts.description: PostMyPace turns your run into a ready-to-post Instagram Story or Reel. Pick one of 80+ templates made for runners, pull distance, time and pace from Apple Health or Health Connect (or type them in), add your photo and share. Free on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Moatly
posts.tagline: Measures your product's moat and the threats testing it
posts.description: Know how defensible your product is before a clone, an AI agent or a platform feature tests it. Moatly reads public evidence (GitHub, AI agent registries, filings, platform release notes) and shows your moat strength, threat pressure and next moves. Free.

posts.name: OpenVisio
posts.tagline: One workspace for your team and its AI coding agents
posts.description: Plan, build, review and ship with people and AI coding agents in one shared workspace — chat, tasks, docs and your codebase, with Claude Code, Codex and more working as teammates.

posts.name: Alysis Code
posts.tagline: Open-source AI coding agent
posts.description: Alysis is a powerful, open-source AI agent for desktop and terminal. Work with files, plan changes, write code, and review the results with your choice of models.

posts.name: Letterpress-1
posts.tagline: One script install to automate growth for your website
posts.description: Letterpress-1 is a coding agent, harness, and IDE that autonomously makes pull requests to improve growth. It'll handle page optimization, blog creation, de-anonymization to outbound, A/B testing, landing page set-up, agent tracking, human tracking, and over 50+ other strategies.

posts.name: AgentTM
posts.tagline: Time-travel debugging for AI coding agents
posts.description: A local debugging tool that records managed Codex sessions and workspace checkpoints so you can inspect changes and restore earlier files into an isolated Git worktree.

posts.name: LiveShortly
posts.tagline: Watch, steer, share and approve your coding agent, live
posts.description: Put your coding agent on a link. Watch every prompt, tool call and diff live, comment into the running agent, and approve risky commands from your phone, if you feel like, share it with other to comment or just watch. Then replay or fork the session in any agent. Free, open source, self-hostable.

posts.name: Meshia
posts.tagline: Your autonomous research lab
posts.description: Meshia brings agents, your team’s knowledge, and compute into one shared workspace. Manage experiments, build on teammates’ work, and recursively improve toward your goals. Find compute from 17+ providers worldwide, combine GPUs and TPUs, and keep your files and context as your research grows.

posts.name: Shipnoted
posts.tagline: Changelog + feedback board for closing the loop on your git
posts.description: Shipnoted is a changelog, feedback board and public roadmap that closes the loop from your git: customers ask, your pull request cites the request, and everyone who asked is told when it ships.

posts.name: Kivo
posts.tagline: Free on device dictation for any Mac app and AI agent
posts.description: Hold a key, speak, and let go. Kivo inserts clean text at your cursor in any Mac app, from email to your AI agent’s prompt box. It removes fillers and resolves corrections. Audio stays on your Mac. Free, with no account. Preview: English only and unsigned.

posts.name: Magic Wonders
posts.tagline: A smart wand to duel, control your home and create magic
posts.description: Magic Wonders is the open platform for magic. Wand One is an AI-powered smart wand for dueling friends, exploring live adventures, controlling your smart home, creating magical experiences, making music and much more. On Kickstarter until Nov 26.

posts.name: Earth Stats
posts.tagline: Live planet statistics on a 3D globe, one number at a time
posts.description: See how fast we're using the planet. Earth Stats counts the carbon left before 1.5 °C, forests, water, energy and every country live, on a 3D Earth that turns to where each number happens. Free, no signup, with a daily quiz.

posts.name: SafeGrd
posts.tagline: Safae database backups that AI can restore but not delete
posts.description: SafeGrd backs up Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, files and mail. Each backup is encrypted on your host and locked with S3 Object Lock, so nothing can delete it early, including an agent holding your admin keys. On a schedule it restores the newest backup, counts every table and row, and signs the result. Agents get an MCP token that can take backups but never delete one. Try it on one database with no account: safegrd try

posts.name: Chronos DB
posts.tagline: The database for the autonomous AI era.
posts.description: The database for the autonomous AI era: every agent works in its own copy of your data, and changes reach main only by your rules or your approval. Postgres on the wire.

posts.name: Cloptima
posts.tagline: AI Gateway, Guardrails & LLM FinOps
posts.description: Cloptima puts your own rules in front of every AI call: a virtual key per app with its own policy, guardrails that mask data before it leaves, tool policy for agents, budgets that block, session replay, an edge gateway inside your network, and prices each call on an attributed ledger before the provider sees a token. Setup is one line.

posts.name: Royak
posts.tagline: AI employees that get the work done for you
posts.description: Hire AI employees, group them into departments and give them real work, then watch every step in a live 3D office. Nothing runs, spends or touches your tools without your permission: approvals, spending caps and pause come with every plan. Free to start.

posts.name: Textwhisk
posts.tagline: Turn selected text into quick actions on your Mac
posts.description: Tired of copying text between apps? Textwhisk puts actions beside selected text: change case, summarize, translate, save snippets, or run custom offline rules and AI prompts. For Apple Silicon Macs. One-time purchase; AI uses your own key.

posts.name: AudioCentral
posts.tagline: Control every app’s audio from your Mac’s menu bar.
posts.description: Designed as a set-and-forget way to control audio for every app and device on your Mac, AudioCentral delivers refined sound in a sleek, user-friendly package. Per-app volume and routing to any device, with equalizers and AI speech isolation built in. AudioCentral works directly with macOS: no kernel extensions, no reboots, no audio-stack surgery — just a clean, native experience built around the system you already use.

posts.name: Releasebeam
posts.tagline: Release infrastructure for developers
posts.description: The release infrastructure for developers. Ship once. Announce everywhere.

posts.name: OrgSync
posts.tagline: Company brain for Claude, ChatGPT & Codex teams
posts.description: AI made every person faster, not the company. Everyone briefs their own AI from memory, so decisions drift and work gets redone. OrgSync fixes the source: one role-aware company brain that every teammate’s AI reads from. Your AI drafts, a person approves, and everyone’s AI works from the latest decision, with citations. Goals and weekly reviews live there too. Access is set by role, never by the model.

posts.name: Translucent AI
posts.tagline: Test infrastructure for hardware teams
posts.description: Agents choose the next physical test and run solver tests within rules a hardware team sets once. Bench tests go to a qualified person. Works with any agent. Physical tests come with a procedure and a forecast. An engineer decides whether to spend the bench time, and an operator enters the result.

posts.name: Vakilat
posts.tagline: AI research for Indian lawyers with "0" hallucinations
posts.description: AI legal system which lawyers can trust with "ZERO" hallucinations, we are building for 2M+ Indian lawyers where they can just upload their docs/images and get results they can actually say in court room with paragraph level citations.

posts.name: StartupFlow AI 2.0
posts.tagline: Find startup credits you actually qualify for.
posts.description: StartupFlow AI finds the cloud credits, AI credits, and accelerator programs which your startup should qualify for. Just one profile and get a ranked shortlist with a clear, plain-English reason behind every match.

posts.name: Index Cyborg
posts.tagline: Get your pages indexed without babysitting Search Engines
posts.description: IndexCyborg automates the boring part of SEO: getting your pages found. Connect your site and it reads your sitemaps, pings Bing, Yandex and co. via IndexNow the moment you publish, and tracks each URL’s real Google status through Search Console, with Google’s exact reasons when a page isn’t indexed. Plus technical SEO checks, alerts, a REST API and an MCP server so your AI coding agent can check indexing too. Built for indie hackers and devs. From $5/mo.

posts.name: BlogFleet
posts.tagline: A fleet of SEO & GEO-optimized blogs for your startup
posts.description: BlogFleet gives your startup a fleet of blogs, each on its own domain, that write and publish themselves. Every run, it plans a new article or an update to an older one for each blog, then links back to your website with UTM tags so you can see the traffic it sends. Connect Google Search Console and compare your startup’s search results before and after your blogs. No writers, no CMS, no setup: just more ways for people to find you.

posts.name: AIRCTRL
posts.tagline: Route, govern, and vault your AI stack without redeploying
posts.description: Stop hardcoding prompts and juggling API keys across AI providers. AIRCTRL gives engineering teams one endpoint and one dashboard for frontier models, prompts, agents, and MCP tools. See the blast radius before any change hits prod, swap models with automatic fallback, and ship prompt updates without redeploying. Hard cost caps, rate limits, and full audit trails stop a runaway agent before it takes prod down. Your keys and secrets are Zero-Knowledge by Design. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Apify Tools
posts.tagline: Free web data tools powered by Apify
posts.description: Free web data tools powered by Apify. Extract YouTube videos, analyze Instagram profiles, scan local markets on Google Maps, and more. No sign-up required for 3 free runs.

posts.name: BollyQuiz
posts.tagline: A Bollywood quiz for your Diwali house party.
posts.description: Turn your Diwali party into a Bollywood game show. Put BollyQuiz on your TV, pick a host, and the whole room plays together. 15 categories you won’t find in a regular quiz, like film plots in office jargon and songs translated literally. Free, nothing to install. It is played as a room, not on separate phones, unlike most Bollywood quizzes online that are made for one person on one phone.

posts.name: Cinder
posts.tagline: A Whoop replacement powered by your Apple Watch
posts.description: Cinder turns the Apple Watch you already wear into a Whoop replacement: recovery and biological age from your HRV, resting heart rate, VO2 max, sleep and movement. It is also a full workout tracker: follow a plan, log sets in seconds, see a muscle map of every session, and replay your runs in 3D with pace. Watch app and Live Activities included, no account, works offline, syncs with Apple Health. Free to download; Premium is $2.99 a month, $17.99 a year, or $30 once.

posts.name: shikhu
posts.tagline: Finally, understand the code your agents write.
posts.description: Shikhu helps you understand the code your agent writes. Ask your agent questions during dev, Shikhu turns them into short quizzes on your own code, and improves your understanding over time. Free, Bring your Own Key (OpenRouter), and Open Source.

posts.name: Seowly
posts.tagline: SEO backlinks on autopilot
posts.description: Seowly finds the backlink opportunities your competitors already earned, writes a personalized pitch for each one, and sends it from your own inbox. Turn on Autopilot and it runs the loop for you: the first email, one follow-up, cancelled the moment someone replies. When a real person answers, Seowly drafts your best response and hands it to you. No rented inboxes, no warmup farm, no spreadsheet of "opportunities" you still have to work through yourself.

posts.name: Kiro bots
posts.tagline: Long-running agents that own a part of your work
posts.description: Kiro bots give you agents that own a part of your work and keep it moving, so you hand off a job once instead of re-explaining it every session. Each bot has a name, one ongoing chat, and its own memory, schedules, dashboard, notes and workspace. It runs parallel sessions, watches them, and redirects work that drifts.

posts.name: 25posts
posts.tagline: Whoop for LinkedIn. Reverse-engineer your algorithm.
posts.description: What works for others may not work for you: your LinkedIn account has its own rules. 25posts connects to your profile, read-only, reads your last 50+ posts, and shows what actually drives your reach: the topics it rewards, the formats it buries, the slots that work, each measured against your own habit. Then it tells you what to do next, safest first, re-reads your drafts before you publish, and schedules them on your best slots.

posts.name: Brainpercent
posts.tagline: Your whole marketing, in one workspace
posts.description: Since our last launch, Brainpercent became one chat that plans, makes and publishes in your brand: AI actors, videos with voiceover, documents, and publishing to 11 channels after you approve.

posts.name: A Perfect Hat for Poe
posts.tagline: A free interactive storybook about a stink bug & six hats
posts.description: Poe is a curmudgeonly stink bug who tries on six hats — cowboy, builder, chef, top hat, bowler, birthday — hunting for one that makes him somebody. A free, narrated, interactive storybook that lives inside Inklings Book Club, the library-card reading app.

posts.name: Photo Checks by Checklist.gg
posts.tagline: Snap a photo. AI checks if the job was done right.
posts.description: New: Photo Checks. Checklists say "done". Photos show it. Now everyone running a checklist takes a photo of each task. AI compares the photo to what "done right" looks like (written in plain words, with optional example photos) and marks it passed, failed or needs review, with time and place saved. Built for cleaning, housekeeping, facilities, retail and field teams who can't be everywhere at once.

posts.name: VibeMetricsAI
posts.tagline: Security & launch checks for vibe-coded apps
posts.description: VibeMetricsAI helps vibe coders and AI-assisted developers check whether their apps are ready to ship. Scan your URL for security and launch-readiness issues across TLS, certificates, CSP, CORS, cookies, authentication, data isolation, redirects, security headers, and more. Get clear Passed, Failed, Warning, and Inconclusive results with evidence—so you can find problems before real users do.

posts.name: FindyLeads
posts.tagline: enriches B2B leads from real-time LinkedIn
posts.description: FindyLeads is a B2B lead generation platform. It finds and enriches contacts from a live dataset of 1 billion people and 450 million companies, surfaces real-time buying signals from LinkedIn and Reddit, and drafts outreach and social posts with AI.

posts.name: TinyResearch + TinySet
posts.tagline: Delegate the deep web work: cited reports and real datasets
posts.description: TinyResearch runs a full investigation and returns a report formatted for decisions: summary, comparison tables, numbered citations. TinySet turns one prompt into a dataset built from public web pages, up to 250 rows, each value backed by a page it read.

posts.name: minimo (photo)
posts.tagline: a free app for compressing photos directly on your phone
posts.description: Large photos are great until you need to send a dozen of them. minimo compresses photos right on your phone, whether you’re working with one image or a whole batch. Pick a preset or adjust quality and dimensions yourself, compare the result, then save or share the smaller copies. Your originals stay untouched. Everything happens on your device: no cloud uploads, no account, no subscription. minimo is free and open source, so you can explore the code yourself.

posts.name: Lodven
posts.tagline: An AI marketing diagnosis agent for startup founders
posts.description: Turn a public URL into a Lodven growth diagnosis preview before deciding whether to unlock the full report.

posts.name: Find a Pro
posts.tagline: Home-service pros checked against state license records
posts.description: Every home-service pro is matched to state license or business records before they're listed: 195,000+ pros in 29 states and DC. Licenses are rechecked every morning, and a pro whose license lapses comes off the list. Nobody pays to be listed or to rank, and your number goes only to the pro you pick. Free, in English and Spanish. Premium adds My Home: your house's record, warranty and insurance coverage, bills and storm radar. The iPhone app adds a LiDAR room scan and a camera tape measure.

posts.name: Greensighter AI
posts.tagline: Hire an AI UI/UX Designer
posts.description: An AI product designer for your team. Assign a ticket in Jira, Linear, Asana or ClickUp. Get designs in your Figma in 24–48 hours, reviewed by a senior designer.

posts.name: saveyor
posts.tagline: Organize your web: save links and notes in one click
posts.description: Save pages, links and highlights in one click, then sort and search them whenever you need. I built Saveyor for myself: I was job hunting, saving tech news, job links and follow-ups, and it got messy. Now I save from Reddit, LinkedIn and Instagram and jot quick notes in one place. No AI yet later only for sorting and search. A friend said: "This has many use cases. Students and researchers have multiple tabs open; bookmarking and finding them is a serious pain, and Saveyor fixed it" -AI reviewed

posts.name: Syntonym Blur Studio
posts.tagline: Detect, draw, or describe what to blur in images & videos
posts.description: Syntonym Blur Studio anonymizes faces, people, vehicles and license plates in images and video. Detect them automatically, draw a region by hand, or just describe what to hide. No install, runs in the browser, exports at original resolution.

posts.name: Renovation Hub
posts.tagline: One expert visit. Vetted bids. Full clarity before you hire
posts.description: Renovation Hub is a guided remodeling platform for homeowners. We combine expert project scoping, vetted contractor bidding, and digital project tools to help clients make better decisions before construction begins — with optional project management when deeper support is needed.

posts.name: TechieDebt
posts.tagline: Measure technical debt. Showcase your engineering standards.
posts.description: Built something you're proud of? Give it the recognition it deserves. TechieDebt lets developers measure, showcase, and benchmark their projects through technical debt scores, public profiles, badges, and a developer leaderboard. Your work. Your standards. Your spotlight.

posts.name: Bibby AI - Claude for Research Papers
posts.tagline: Introducing the Notebook - a complete workspace of research.
posts.description: The Notebook is new: one place to dump reading notes, figures and half-formed ideas, then pull them straight into your paper. Also shipped in the last 6 weeks: Rich Text mode (write like Word, we handle the LaTeX), handwriting-to-LaTeX, a figure studio with 6,000+ scientific icons, translation to 20 languages and 10,000+ citation styles in the editor, and an AI paper reviewer. Free to start, 1800+ journal templates. For researchers and students in Academia and Industry.

posts.name: Pregnancy Care & Tracker App
posts.tagline: Track pregnancy and baby size right from your home screen🌸
posts.description: A clean, privacy-conscious pregnancy tracker for expecting parents! 👶✨ Follow week-by-week fetal growth with fun size comparisons 🥑, log daily symptoms 📝, set appointment reminders 📅, hydration reminders💧 and capture memories with photo journals 📸. Track key milestones and count kicks 🦶 right from your home screen with customizable widgets! 📱💕

posts.name: Local Office
posts.tagline: Private AI for office paperwork
posts.description: Private AI for office paperwork. Answers cite the exact page, and no file leaves your computer.

posts.name: Programmable Info
posts.tagline: Enrich a list in a minute, or run a sales agent every week
posts.description: Enrich a list in a minute, or let an agent find new companies every week. Drop in websites, names or a CRM export and get the whole sheet back: tech stack, socials, HQ, hiring and checked work emails, each value with its source. Or write one sentence and get an agent that runs weekly: it finds only new companies (from your site, SEC, SAM.gov or FDA filings), researches each one and drafts the outreach, paused until you approve. Run it from Sheets, Zapier or a link. 500 credits included.

posts.name: SaaS Health
posts.tagline: Stripe, ads, analytics and AI costs in one SaaS dashboard
posts.description: SaaS Health connects Stripe, Google Ads, Meta, GA4, Search Console, your AI providers and your product database in one dashboard. See MRR, churn, CAC, break-even and AI cost per unit, plus a health audit with an AI recovery plan.

posts.name: Ordo
posts.tagline: Your bookings, organized into intelligent trips.
posts.description: Most travel apps ask you to enter most things manually. Ordo doesn't. Just forward your booking confirmation emails and your itinerary builds itself — flights, hotels, connections, layovers, all in one place. Multi-traveler support, real-time flight status, and weather for every leg of your trip are already live.

posts.name: Stynar
posts.tagline: Find leads. Launch campaigns. Let AI handle outbound.
posts.description: Stynar is an AI-powered outbound sales platform that helps teams discover leads, find decision-makers, create personalised campaigns, automate follow-ups, manage replies and book meetings. Just tell its AI agent what you want to achieve, and let Stynar handle the outbound workflow.

posts.name: Animdock Stock
posts.tagline: Thousands of Free Stock Images
posts.description: Photos, backgrounds, textures, 3D renders and transparent PNG elements — searchable by keyword, free to download.

posts.name: The World of Nietzsche
posts.tagline: Listen to his books. Explore his letters. Talk to his AI.
posts.description: Explore Nietzsche through 26 works, personal letters, full audiobooks, summaries, and conversations with an AI interpretation of him. We translated his writings from the original German and created an AI voice inspired by historical descriptions. Read, listen, and follow his life through a biography and historical photographs.

posts.name: Kertas
posts.tagline: Paper mockup tool for your design. Zero uploads, and free
posts.description: A paper mockup tool for your design. Your image becomes a sheet of paper you pose in 3D. Embed it on your website, export it as a PNG or an MP4. Nothing is uploaded, everything runs in your browser.

posts.name: CiteYT
posts.tagline: Fight fake-news with real-time sources for YouTube
posts.description: Hold claims accountable as you watch. CiteYT brings AI fact-checks, context, and source links alongside YouTube videos so you can question misinformation and verify the evidence for yourself. Try the free public demos; real-time checking of your own videos is in invite-only early access.

posts.name: Launchef
posts.tagline: Free launch platform where makers get real upvotes
posts.description: Launchef is a free launch platform: share what you built, get upvotes and real feedback, and the best products of the week lead a live leaderboard. No paid spots, no paid boosts.

posts.name: Hebel
posts.tagline: The best of 20,000 newsletters, written for your goals
posts.description: Hebel reads 20,000 newsletters every night and writes you one email: a short chapter for each of your goals with every source linked, one small action for today, and a TLDR-style list of the day's links. No app, no password.

posts.name: Decision
posts.tagline: Scout opportunities from your network
posts.description: When we see more in what we have, we can do more with what we have. Know easily what your curated network gives or does, instead of trying to follow them everywhere.

posts.name: BookTuning Reading Room
posts.tagline: New: a free reading timer that plays your book's playlist
posts.description: New: the Reading Room, a free reading timer inside BookTuning. Pick a book, light a candle and read in sprints of 15, 25, 45 or 60 minutes (or 5–120). The book's Spotify playlist plays while you read and pauses for breaks. Add rain, a crackling fire or night wind, choose one of 20 pixel-art rooms, and stamp a library card with pages, minutes, pace and a 14-day candle streak. No account needed. No ads while you read.

posts.name: launchAEO
posts.tagline: Get you brand recommended by AI - (Free tier included)
posts.description: Answer Engine Optimisation for brands that want to be cited in AI answers. launchAEO measures grounded citations, retrieval, and the next edit.

posts.name: Litehaus
posts.tagline: AI investor outreach, from your pitch deck to their inbox
posts.description: Raise money while you sleep. Litehaus turns your pitch deck into personalized investor outreach for any kind of project. Find relevant investors, launch email campaigns with automatic follow-ups, and manage replies in one workspace. AI helps draft answers using your project context, with optional automatic replies and a review window. Upload your PDF, review your campaign, and launch with 250 free emails.

posts.name: OpenATS
posts.tagline: Run your own internal hiring platform in minutes
posts.description: OpenATS is the hiring platform you own, not rent. Most hiring tools bill you per seat, hold your candidate data hostage, and leave your team juggling spreadsheets and inboxes. OpenATS puts it all in one place: a drag-and-drop pipeline, team ratings and discussions, role-based access, a public careers page, and offers and interviews. Built for startups and fast-growing teams that want to hire fast without another monthly subscription. Open source, self-hosted, zero per-seat fees.

posts.name: Deenez
posts.tagline: DNS management with context, validation, and audit trails
posts.description: Deenez helps teams manage DNS records across Cloudflare, TransIP, Hetzner, Oxxa, Neostrada and future providers with workspaces, RBAC, SPF tools, validation, monitoring, scheduling, and audit trails.

posts.name: FaaStr Flow
posts.tagline: FaaStr Flow is an AI co-founder C-suite in Google Chat
posts.description: FaaStr Flow is an AI co-founder C-suite for early-stage SaaS startups. It installs into Google Workspace, runs in Google Chat, and bundles FaaStr Ideas (validate the idea), FaaStr Products (design and ship the MVP) and FaaStr Capital (fund it, grow it, sell it) on one company knowledge graph.
